name: astfim_partial_eval
description: Eval companion of astfim_partial: the SAME pure derivation, sampled from the parent corpus EVAL split only (fixed/eval.jsonl), so the package-level holdout of astfim_v1 is inherited exactly (train and eval share zero packages). 100 rows. Not registered in assemble_sft_v5 SCENARIO_FILES: that assembler takes train files and cuts its own 3% per-family package holdout, so a per-family eval input has no slot there - this file stands alone for family-level evals.
novelty_note: Not a new family: the eval-side instantiation of astfim_partial (family stamp stays astfim_partial). Exists as its own spec so the eval split is reproducible from the checked-in JSON instead of an ad-hoc override, and so reruns never touch the train derivation's sampling.

provenance.license: CRAN package sources (per-package licenses, mostly GPL-3/MIT)
provenance.note: corrected astfim_v1 fixed EVAL split (parent package-level holdout); seeded reservoir sample, eval packages only

difficulty.knobs: retyped partial length k (1..3) and parent span kind (function_body / top_level_block / argument_list)
